description: Silent-switch defaults per installer ENGINE. Derived from Appendix L.2, which stays the prose form the agent reads in Phase 2; tests/SwitchCatalog.Tests.ps1 fails if the two drift apart. Every value here is a CLAIM: it is the documented default for the engine, not a fact about the file in front of you, and it stays a claim until a run proves it. There are deliberately NO per-application entries - applications are a long tail whose switches rot silently, engines are a short list that is stable for years.

notes: /NORESTART is mandatory: without it Inno reboots the machine by itself (App. L.7).
/SILENT shows a progress bar, /VERYSILENT shows none.
/SUPPRESSMSGBOXES only takes effect together with one of the silent switches.
PER-USER BY DEFAULT: add /ALLUSERS or the install lands in the SYSTEM profile when run by Intune, with exit code 0 and nothing in HKLM (App. L.7).

Repair by re-running the installer is NOT universally safe: some builds hang when they find an existing install of the same version and branch into their own 'remove previous version' flow, which under /S in a SYSTEM task never completes (measured on JetBrains PyCharm 2026.2.2, App. L.7). Where that happens, Repair is an explicit uninstall followed by an install.

Where that happens, Repair is an explicit uninstall followed by an install.
